title: Customer login via email and password
description: A user can log in with the email/password test account (the app's real auth: signInWithEmailAndPassword) and reach an authenticated state.

steps.description: Navigate to http://localhost:3000/auth
In the login form, fill the field labeled 'البريد الإلكتروني أو رقم الهاتف' with cveeez1@OUTLOOK.COM
Fill the password field 'كلمة المرور' with CV20259
Click the 'تسجيل الدخول' (Login) button

MEANINGFUL ASSERTION: verify login succeeded — an authenticated header control is visible (e.g. 'تسجيل الخروج' Logout, or 'حسابي' My account), and the page is no longer the login form. Do NOT assert only the URL.

title: Browse stores/products and open a product detail page
description: An authenticated user can browse and open a product detail page that has an Add-to-cart control.

steps.description: Log in with cveeez1@OUTLOOK.COM / CV20259 (email/password) if not already logged in
Navigate to http://localhost:3000/ and then to the stores listing (/store) if needed
Open any store and then open a product detail page (or navigate to a /product/[id] page)

MEANINGFUL ASSERTION: verify the product detail page shows a product title and price, and an 'أضف للسلة' (Add to cart) button is visible. If no products/stores exist, FAIL and report it. Do NOT assert only the URL.

title: Add to cart, checkout, choose driver, confirm Cash-on-Delivery order
description: A logged-in user can add a product to the cart, enter a delivery address, choose a driver, and confirm a Cash-on-Delivery order with a visible success confirmation.

steps.description: Log in with cveeez1@OUTLOOK.COM / CV20259 if not already logged in
Open a product detail page and click 'أضف للسلة' (Add to cart)
Open the cart (/cart); verify the item is present, then proceed to checkout (/checkout)
Fill the delivery address fields (عنوان التوصيل) with a test address; select country مصر and a city if required
Proceed to the delivery step (/checkout/delivery) and choose a driver (اختيار السائق)
Confirm the order as Cash on Delivery (الدفع عند الاستلام / تأكيد الطلب)
MEANINGFUL ASSERTION: verify an order-success confirmation is visible (e.g. success text such as 'تم تأكيد الطلب' / 'تم إنشاء الطلب' / a confirmation/order number). Do NOT assert only the URL.

title: Placed order appears in the customer account
description: After placing an order, it appears in the account order history under /account.

steps.description: Log in with cveeez1@OUTLOOK.COM / CV20259 if not already logged in
Navigate to http://localhost:3000/account
MEANINGFUL ASSERTION: verify the orders section (طلباتي) is visible and lists at least one order row. Do NOT assert only the URL.

title: Seller login and dashboard
description: The seller test account can log in and reach the seller dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to http://localhost:3000/auth/seller/login
Log in with cveeez1@OUTLOOK.COM / CV20259 (email/password). If the page redirects to the general /auth, log in there and open the seller portal ('افتح بوابة التاجر')
Navigate to http://localhost:3000/seller/dashboard if not redirected automatically
MEANINGFUL ASSERTION: verify the seller dashboard is displayed (a dashboard heading/section or seller navigation is visible). Do NOT assert only the URL.

title: Seller adds a new product
description: The seller can create a new product with name, selling price, cost price (lower than selling), quantity and category, and save it.

steps.description: Log in as seller (cveeez1@OUTLOOK.COM / CV20259) if not already logged in
Navigate to http://localhost:3000/seller/products/new
Fill the product name (اسم المنتج) with 'منتج اختبار QA 100'
Fill the selling price (سعر البيع) with 100
Fill the cost/purchase price (سعر الشراء) with 60 (must be lower than the selling price)
Fill the quantity (الكمية) with 10
Select a category (الفئة)
Save the product (حفظ / إضافة منتج)
MEANINGFUL ASSERTION: verify the product was saved — a success message is visible OR the app redirects to /seller/products and the new product name appears. Do NOT assert only the URL.

title: New product appears in the seller product list
description: The newly created product is listed on the seller's products page.

steps.description: Log in as seller (cveeez1@OUTLOOK.COM / CV20259) if not already logged in
Navigate to http://localhost:3000/seller/products
MEANINGFUL ASSERTION: verify the product 'منتج اختبار QA 100' created in TC006 is visible in the product list. Do NOT assert only the URL.
